You will remove barriers to care, resulting in a truly exceptional in-office patient experience. You are the steward of the space and ensure the look and feel of the office lobby are on brand with the One Medical experience. You will be the first point of contact for our patients, as well as provide any other support as requested by the Practice Coordinator, Operations Manager, or providers. You are a strong team player and use your innovative problem solving skills to tackle various tasks and challenges. You combine excellent specimen collection technique with tactful interpersonal skills during every interaction with your patients, at both the front desk and in the lab. You have a strong grasp of verbal and written communication. You are able to identify opportunities and deliver on customer-centric solutions while using empathy, focus, and compassion in all interactions with patients and teammates. jobs.description_text: Role Overview We are looking for a Perception Software Engineer to design, integrate, and deploy ML-based perception software within our ADAS stack. This engineer will collaborate with ML engineers, embedded software developers, and systems teams to deliver production-ready solutions across Lucid’s vehicle platforms. Responsibilities Research, develop, and integrate bird’s-eye-view (BEV) transformer models for perception tasks. Research and develop state-of-the-art machine-learning-based prediction solutions for production perception systems. Develop and maintain comprehensive unit and integration tests. Deploy and optimize ML models on embedded platforms. Write production-grade C++ code aligned with MISRA/AUTOSAR standards. Develop and maintain diagnostic pipelines for perception modules. Debug and resolve static analysis violations and performance bottlenecks. Collaborate with multi-disciplinary teams across ML, perception, systems, and safety. Qualifications Strong foundation in software integration, operating systems used in embedded environments, including QNX and Ubuntu, and embedded software development. You will greet clients promptly, consult with technicians, accurately document client concerns for diagnosis and repair, and explain all service options to clients, including time and cost estimates. You will also track all client vehicles through the maintenance and repair process, ensuring that work done meets Lucid's quality standards before vehicles are returned to clients. Responsibilities: Ensure clients are informed throughout the service experience from initial contact to vehicle handover Conduct comprehensive inspections and thorough check-in processes for customer vehicles, identifying and reporting any damage or visible wear Check in new vehicles and document transport damage on PDI vehicles, ensuring accurate notation on the Bill of Lading (BOL) and processing through internal channels for proper documentation Manage and facilitate loaner agreements, coordinating rental vehicle requests for customers as needed, including arranging Lyft rides for convenience Uphold the Customer Satisfaction Index (CSI) KPI as a fundamental aspect of our operations, actively ensuring that customers are delighted with the quality of service provided Review and revise work orders after technicians and detailers complete their tasks, guaranteeing accurate documentation and precise time punches

jobs.title: Service Assistant
jobs.description_text: The Service Assistant position works with other members of the service team to make sure the day-to-day operation runs smoothly. This position requires the ability to handle a rapidly changing workload and can prioritize accordingly. This is an excellent opportunity to gain experience, learn, and develop your career within the automotive industry. Responsibilities: Provides a world-class customer experience to all Lucid clients, both internal and external Vehicle drives include dropping off or picking up customer vehicles and/or loaners, runs to the Bodyshop, test charging at EA (Electrify America) charge stations, among others. Arranging Lyft rides for internal vehicle moves per request Assist with Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) carrier preparation and vehicle hand-over. jobs.title: Senior Electrical Hardware Test Engineer, Energy Storage
jobs.description_text: Position Summary: Join Redwood Materials to validate the high-voltage power electronics behind the world’s energy storage systems. You’ll design and run validation tests on components and assemblies operating at 400–2000VDC and 480–800VAC. You’ll work directly from schematics, Altium layouts, and datasheets to understand switching topologies, gate drive, isolation, protection, and thermal behavior, then use that understanding to build sharper tests. When something fails, you’ll probe the circuit, isolate the fault, and drive root cause to the component level. You’ll design and source custom PCBAs for characterization, build electrical-focused test infrastructure with mechanical and software elements, and write Python tools to automate testing and analyze data. Working alongside design, reliability, and abuse engineers on FMEAs and test plans, you’ll turn complex data into design and process improvements that ship. If you thrive at the bench, love finding the real cause of a failure, and want your work to matter from day one, this is your role. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Design, set up, and execute validation tests on high-voltage power electronics components and assemblies Read and work directly from schematics, Altium layouts, and datasheets to understand circuit behavior and inform test design Debug and diagnose hardware hands-on — probe circuits, isolate faults, and drive root cause investigations to the component level Design, fabricate, and source custom PCBAs
